purpose: Authoritative public-safe coarse-class and optional-phase inputs for the shared portable core.

selection.basis: Recognize the work from its description; profiles may overlap within one investigation.

questions.text: What result do you need: an evidence assessment, a screened evidence table, a checked tool/result, a simulation, or a validated prediction workflow?
Is this one bounded task or several investigations? What separate questions, deliverables or cases are already planned?
Is this a first pass or a detailed review with independent checks, revised methods or repeated validation?
For computational work, is the method already working, or must software, data preparation and the execution environment be developed or repaired?

selection.question_policy: Give a supported coarse class allowance first under visible comparable-task/readiness assumptions. Exact phases and bounded confirmation are optional refinements, not numeric gates. Preserve conditional bases with unknown extra scope. Ask only unanswered material questions; users never supply token guesses.
selection.unmatched_work: Unknown: do not select the nearest numeric band merely to produce a number.
selection.phase_question: Which focused deliverable is needed: understand/setup/launch/confirm an existing workflow; simulation implementation, correction or sweep; a synthetic predictive prototype, real-data model development/validation, or integration/debugging using existing component models?
selection.unsupported_scope_reason: The bundled calibration covers bounded AI development and existing-workflow operations, not whole/greenfield, included raw-data-preparation, repeat-only, supervision-only or external-only solver-resource scope. Clarify separately comparable tasks; no nearest-band fallback.

operation_comparison.interpretation: Conservative intake guard retaining focused startup examples, not empirically measured maxima, token rates or guaranteed coverage. Larger limits require a targeted comparability decision.

range_method.grid: Positive values 1 and 3 times each integer power of ten.
range_method.rule: For a numeric anchor, use the largest grid value at or below it and the smallest grid value at or above it.
range_method.interpretation: Provisional rounded planning heuristic around bundled references; not observed lower/upper bounds, a fitted distribution, confidence interval, lifetime certification or guaranteed coverage.
range_method.coverage: Community reference set for coarse planning only; references are not additive work items or independent replications.
range_method.missing_breakdown_policy: One comparable task/session is a visible conditional planning base, not a confirmed scale or investigation total. Extra scope remains unknown; aggregate only explicit nonoverlapping work units.
range_method.composition_policy: Sum only explicit disjoint hypothetical work units once. Do not sum parent/child or contained stage/cycle references.
range_method.operational_rule: For existing_workflow_operation only: apply the same outward 1/3-decade grid to the minimum and maximum of selected operational-preparation references. The resulting envelope is provisional and not a guaranteed lower bound.

profiles.label: Evidence review and outcome assessment
profiles.description: Review available evidence against a stated question or outcome and explain what is supported, missing or uncertain.
recognize_by: A review of existing results rather than generating new simulation results
A bounded assessment with a written conclusion
assumptions: One bounded assessment session with relevant evidence already available.
Task attribution and lifetime completeness are unresolved; treat this as a planning analogy only.
not_covered: Producing underlying scientific results
An entire investigation
A calibrated relationship between evidence volume and tokens

external_compute.note: No external job estimate is attached to this profile.

profiles.label: Literature screening and bounded synthesis
profiles.description: Screen relevant documents, extract comparable evidence and summarize it for a focused question.
recognize_by: A focused evidence table and concise synthesis
Screening and extraction rather than a whole research program
assumptions: One bounded screening/extraction session comparable in scope to the anchor.
Extra manuscript writing or deep synthesis is not automatically covered.
not_covered: All literature work in an investigation
A calibrated document-count or page-count conversion
Unspecified follow-up searches, rewrites or independent reviews

external_compute.note: External numerical execution was not measured for this task.

profiles.label: Tool verification and bounded analysis
profiles.description: Check a numerical or analytical tool against references, investigate discrepancies and prepare a short report.
recognize_by: A bounded pilot verifying a tool or result
Reference comparisons and repeat checks included in the task
assumptions: One verification pilot including checks and writeup.
Repeat-only and development-only token consumption are unknown.
not_covered: Full simulation development
A pure repeat-use execution rate
A complete prediction pipeline or large data-analysis investigation

external_compute.note: Lifecycle and external runtime remain separate from this AI planning estimate.

profiles.label: Numerical simulation development and execution
profiles.description: Build or adapt a scientific simulation, make the environment work, run cases and check results.
recognize_by: A model or solver requiring external CPU/GPU execution
Environment debugging, build probes, case runs and result checks
assumptions: Without a phase, use the envelope of implementation/correction/sweep bands as alternatives, not a summed workflow total.
External runtime/resource references remain separate from AI token planning.
not_covered: Unresolved or whole-project scope, repeat-only execution and supervision-only usage
Future runtime, utilized CPU/GPU, cost, capacity and whole-investigation totals

external_compute.note: External runtime and hardware observations remain context only and do not convert to token estimates.

profiles.label: Predictive modeling workflow development and validation
profiles.description: Prepare an integrated training, evaluation and prediction workflow and validate generalization.
recognize_by: Model fitting and held-out validation inside an integrated cycle
Potential data/dependency/memory/identity repairs before successful execution
assumptions: Without a phase, use the envelope of synthetic-prototype, real-data and integration bands as alternatives, not an additive sequence.
External timing and hardware references are context only.
not_covered: Unresolved or whole-project scope, repeat-only execution and supervision-only usage
Future runtime, utilized CPU/GPU, cost, capacity and whole-investigation totals

external_compute.note: External runtime and hardware observations remain context only and do not convert to token estimates.

profiles.label: Existing workflow: understand, prepare, launch and confirm
profiles.description: A bounded AI operational task around an existing documented simulation, tool or workflow; external execution is separate.
recognize_by: Run or launch an existing workflow with instruction/input review and startup confirmation
Bounded command/environment preparation and local checks, not scientific-model development
assumptions: One focused AI operation: read/understand existing instructions and inputs, establish readiness, construct commands, launch or report blocked attempt, then confirm startup/status/errors and provide a short handoff.
Environment/tool/input readiness is a comparison assumption unless explicitly provided.
Operational references support a provisional 0.3-3 million transfer envelope and are not a successful-launch minimum.
not_covered: External solver CPU/GPU runtime, utilization, cost and resource provisioning
Scientific-model development, raw scientific data preparation, new methods and whole-job/investigation consumption
Open-ended setup repair, unresolved access/permissions, continuous monitoring and additional independent scientific review

external_compute.note: Operational AI allowance only; no external resource or duration conversion.

drivers.effect: More evidence, cases or distinct outputs may require more bounded tasks; no token-per-document, row, fit or case law is measured.
Deeper extraction, method revision and independent synthesis can create additional tasks. Within-session token multipliers are unmeasured.
Specify whether checks are already inside a task or are separate reviews.
Environment repairs, failed builds and duplicate runs add work, but repeat-only rates are unknown.
Scheduling metadata only; do not multiply or divide token bands by concurrency.
